## AI engineer & principal consultant — agentic systems that hold up in production

InertialRange Labs AB is the consulting practice of **Farrukh Nauman, PhD**. I design and ship AI-agent systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — wired to production data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, and SQL databases.

I build the thing and write the code, with the test discipline and result-level evaluation that make agents trustworthy in production — not slide decks. When an engagement needs it, I also take **interim / fractional leadership** of data and AI teams.

### How to engage

From a two-week audit to a multi-month interim lead — sized to the problem, with clear scope and acceptance criteria up front.

- **2-week Discovery** — data readiness, prioritized opportunity map, success metrics.
- **4-week Pilot** — fixed scope, acceptance criteria, working build, handoff plan.
- **Hands-on AI engineering** — embedded delivery of agents, guardrails, evals, and tool contracts.
- **Fractional / interim lead** — senior technical leadership for data & AI teams.
